title: Normalization and uniqueness of exact coherent comparison presentations
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme] and exact comparison presentation D [def-pbc-coherent-etale-exact-comparison], its explicit Ext maps form a normalized family [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]. If X has compact underlying topological space and its diagonal is a closed immersion, every normalized additive comparison equivalence agrees, in every degree and on every quasi-coherent coefficient module, with D.map.

proof.text: Exact-functor Ext maps preserve composition and short-exact extension classes. Coefficient naturality gives the ordinary naturality squares. The morphism of short exact sequences with components d identifies the mapped extension class with the target extension class, giving all boundary squares. Terminal evaluation in degree zero gives the specified section unit. Thus the constructed family is normalized. The compiled proof reuses the proved exact-functor comparison helpers from QcoherentNormalizedComparison.

Use the established common quasi-coherent effacements from QcoherentNormalizedComparison and normalized_unique to identify the constructed family with any supplied normalized family. No choice of presentation data from an existence theorem is used in any definition. The already proved coherentEtaleMap_app supplies the canonical coefficient formula without unfolding the comparison construction.
